name: Running Chat Assistant
description: Runs and tests a Chat Assistant flow (trigger: Chat In) as an Agent in the real Chat Assistant page: `robomotion agent` push → create → start → chat, guided and conversational, with an edit → push → start --draft → chat loop. Use when the user says "test the chatbot", "try the assistant", "open the chat", "talk to the agent", or asks to run a flow that starts at Chat In.
